description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeePunchInOutController class, which handles the logic for punch-in and punch-out operations within the OrangeHRM attendance module. It extends an abstract Vue controller and utilizes traits and services to determine the appropriate UI component and properties based on employee attendance records and request parameters.
